description: Versioned multi-hop, relational, narrative, and out-of-scope question answering and retrieval benchmark evaluated over SEC 10-K enterprise filings.

dev.purpose: Parameter tuning, prompt development, router threshold calibration

test.purpose: Held-out evaluation of 5-way retrieval and end-to-end question answering ablation

category_definitions.single_hop: Queries requiring finding a single direct attribute, executive officer, headquarters location, or competitor.
category_definitions.two_hop: Relational queries requiring traversing parent-subsidiary or corporate connection edges (e.g. subsidiaries of subsidiaries).
category_definitions.multi_hop: Aggregation or multi-entity synthesis questions where no single document or node contains the full answer.
category_definitions.out_of_scope: Questions concerning unmentioned entities or private corporate data not disclosed in SEC 10-K filings, where the only valid answer is an explicit refusal.

ground_truth_policy: Ground truth answers, chunk IDs, and graph facts were established by manual inspection of SEC 10-K filings (Items 1, 1A, 7, 8, and Exhibit 21). No ground truth was synthesized by the model under test.
citation_invariant_policy: Every factual claim must cite evidence labels [G#] or [P#]. 100% of cited labels must resolve to chunks retrieved for that request; unresolved labels fail validation.
